detail.longDescription:
When the AI bubble pops, will the skill of writing software without LLMs become more valued?

When capacity and access for/to LLM resources become more scarce and expensive, will brain led development  become a priority?

When people start associating AI with shitty, low quality, bug ridden and expensive software... Will those of us coding without it be at an advantage?

#Programming #FuckAI #NoAI
